visual_review.notes: Full face: Calm Spell, 1 Energy, no Power; Reaction; choose any unit; +1 Might this turn for each distinct Bird, Cat, Dog, Poro tag among your units.

findings: Thwonk! chooses an attacking unit of either player; it does not require an enemy. Repeat adds two Energy with independently declared targets. Stun neither exhausts nor deals damage.

Friendship gives a chosen unit temporary Might equal to the distinct named tags among the spell controller’s units on the board at resolution. Each tag counts at most once; opponents, hand/trash and token factory-card tags do not contribute.
